pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Smiling with His Gloved Hands on His Hips Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman stands smiling with his gloved hands on his hips in this printable coloring page, wearing shorts and oversized shoes beneath his striped straw. His rounded nose, cup handle, and wide eyes stand out against a blank background. The coloring sheet has broad enclosed areas and only a few small facial details.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Firing the Peashooter From His Fingertip Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman firing the Peashooter from his fingertip, with three round projectiles, a raised thumb, and his other hand on his hip. His smiling face and wide stance fill most of the coloring sheet. Plain shorts, large shoes, and a striped straw provide distinct sections within the bold outlines.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Drinking Through the Straw in His Own Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman drinks through the long curved straw in his own head in this printable coloring page, puffing his cheeks while resting both hands on his hips. The striped straw loops from the liquid inside his cup to his mouth. Wide open clothing areas contrast with the smaller facial shapes on this uncluttered coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Floating as a Ghost with a Heart on His Chest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman floating as a ghost, with a heart on his chest, open gloved hands, and a worried expression beneath his straw. A curved tail replaces his legs above an oval ground shadow. The coloring sheet keeps the background empty, leaving large spaces inside his cup head and flowing ghost body.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman in His Evil Ending Form with a Broken Handle and Pointed Teeth Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman appears in his evil ending form in this printable coloring page, showing a broken handle, pointed teeth, narrowed eyes, and a flame above his head. One gloved hand rests on his hip while the other reaches outward. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing areas with smaller triangular teeth and jagged edges around the broken handle.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Piloting His Small Airplane Above Inkwell Isle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman piloting his small airplane above Inkwell Isle, gripping the controls as a propeller, rounded clouds, and mountainous islands surround him. Rivets divide the cockpit rim and engine casing into smaller details. The coloring sheet leaves wider spaces across the wings, cloud shapes, and open sky around the plane.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Unleashing the Energy Beam Super Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman unleashes his Energy Beam super attack in this printable coloring page, spreading his gloved hands as a long wavy blast rises from his head. Droplet shapes surround the beam while his legs brace apart. Large flame-like contours and a mostly blank background make the attack the main feature of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Summoning His Giant Ghost Super Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman summoning his giant ghost super attack, with a muscular spirit, clenched fists, and swirling trails towering above his raised hand. The smaller Mugman stands below with a broad smile and spread feet. Curving ghost contours contrast with the clothing and facial details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Carrying the Collected Soul Contracts Outside the Devil's Casino Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman carries a stack of collected soul contracts outside the Devil's Casino in this printable coloring page, walking past a curtained entrance with curved steps. Rolled scroll ends and his overlapping gloves create small enclosed details. The coloring sheet gives larger open areas to his face, shorts, shoes, and the casino doorway behind him.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Reviving Cuphead's Ghost with a Parry Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman reviving Cuphead's ghost with a parry, jumping upward to touch the heart beneath Cuphead's smiling face and floating halo. Motion marks emphasize the contact and Mugman's leap. Their striped straws, open gloves, and curling ghost tail supply distinct shapes across a coloring sheet with very little background.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Hugging His Brother Cuphead Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman hugs his brother Cuphead in this printable coloring page, standing shoulder to shoulder with their arms around each other and smiles beneath their striped straws. Both wear shorts, gloves, and rounded shoes. The coloring sheet concentrates on the pair, with clear facial shapes, broad clothing sections, and an otherwise empty background.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Receiving a Magic Potion From Elder Kettle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman receiving a magic potion from Elder Kettle, who holds a round corked bottle beside a table and curtained circular window. Elder Kettle's glasses, mustache, and vest add smaller details around the central exchange. Wooden floorboards and a low stool complete the cottage setting on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Choosing a Charm at Porkrind's Emporium Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman chooses a charm at Porkrind's Emporium in this printable coloring page, pointing toward a heart-shaped pendant displayed on the counter beneath Porkrind's watchful eye. Bottles stand on a wall shelf above the wooden shop fittings. The coloring sheet pairs broad character shapes with smaller charm outlines, wood grain, and the shopkeeper's eyepatch.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Studying Airplane Blueprints Beside Canteen Hughes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman studying airplane blueprints beside Canteen Hughes, who points at a propeller plane drawing spread across a slanted outdoor table. Hughes wears a scarf, belted flight suit, and fur-trimmed collar. The coloring sheet includes small aircraft details and grassy tufts around wider spaces in the characters and blueprint.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Protecting the Legendary Chalice's Urn Inside a Mausoleum Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman protects the Legendary Chalice's urn inside a mausoleum in this printable coloring page, raising one gloved hand toward a ghost beneath a tall stone arch. The lidded urn stands behind him on a pedestal with a diamond motif. Stone blocks and floor tiles divide the coloring sheet into larger geometric sections around the figures.

pages.title: Mugman Reaching for the Legendary Chalice's Cookie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman accepting the Astral Cookie from the Legendary Chalice on Inkwell Isle Four, with a star-shaped cookie and distant lighthouse. The floating Chalice reaches toward Mugman's open glove above a rocky shoreline. Small cookie dots, grass tufts, and the winding lighthouse path contrast with broad character spaces on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Riding the Ferry to Inkwell Isle Four Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman riding the ferry to Inkwell Isle Four, waving from a wooden deck beside a railing, lifebuoy, and smoking funnel. A lighthouse rises beyond the rippling water in the distance. The coloring sheet mixes broad sky and character spaces with narrower railings, deck planks, and rope details.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Jumping Across a Woodland Gap in Forest Follies Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman jumps across a woodland gap in Forest Follies in this printable coloring page, stretching his arms wide between grassy ledges topped with small flowers. Tall trees frame his airborne pose while bushes fill the lower space. The coloring sheet has large clothing shapes alongside smaller petals, leaves, and uneven edges along the cliffs.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Hopping Across Leaf Platforms Carried By Mosquitoes in Treetop Trouble Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman hopping across leaf platforms carried by mosquitoes in Treetop Trouble, with spread arms, large veined leaves, and clouds overhead. Two long-nosed insects hold the leaves above the treetops. Their thin legs and wing outlines add small details beneath the broader leaf and character sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Walking Upside Down on the Ceiling in Funhouse Frazzle Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman walks upside down on the ceiling in Funhouse Frazzle in this printable coloring page, alongside another cup-headed figure above spirals, stars, and patterned panels. Curved platforms project from the wall beneath the pair. The coloring sheet combines broad open wall spaces with smaller decorations and repeated stripes around the funhouse interior.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Facing the Root Pack in a Vegetable Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman facing the Root Pack in a vegetable patch, with clenched gloves opposite a frowning potato, onion, and three-eyed carrot. Rows of leafy plants fill the foreground around the oversized vegetables. Their expressive faces and the soil's small curved marks create finer sections on this garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Dodging Goopy Le Grande in a Woodland Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman dodges Goopy Le Grande in a woodland clearing in this printable coloring page, leaning away as the round boss bounces above grass and a spotted mushroom. Tall trunks and rounded bushes frame the action. Motion lines beneath Goopy contrast with his broad body and Mugman's smaller clothing shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Battling Cagney Carnation in a Flower Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman battling Cagney Carnation in a flower meadow, aiming his fingertip toward the towering flower's pointed nose, broad petals, and thorny stem. Round shots cross the space between the figures. The coloring sheet includes exposed roots, small meadow flowers, and grass around the larger character and petal areas.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Facing Ribby and Croaks Inside Their Riverboat Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman faces Ribby and Croaks inside their riverboat in this printable coloring page, raising his fists opposite the two boxing frogs beneath a hanging ceiling lamp. A large window reveals water, clouds, and a paddlewheel boat. The coloring sheet combines clear character outlines with wooden planks, a lifebuoy, and small rivets around the window.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Jumping Over Beppi the Clown's Bumper Car at the Carnival Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman jumps over Beppi the Clown's bumper car at the carnival in this printable coloring page, lifting his knees above the clown's round headlights and striped hat. Bunting stretches across a tent in the background. Broad car panels and character shapes contrast with smaller glove creases and carnival details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Confronting Baroness Von Bon Bon Outside Her Candy Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman confronting Baroness Von Bon Bon outside her candy castle, with a candy-cane staff, patterned gown, and towers topped by waffle cones. Mugman raises an open hand toward the taller Baroness. Repeated oval decorations, icing edges, and striped columns supply smaller areas throughout this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Standing on a Cloud Platform While Facing Grim Matchstick Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman stands on a cloud platform while facing Grim Matchstick in this printable coloring page, opposite the dragon's pointed teeth, small wings, and long curved tail. Both figures occupy separate clouds in an open sky. The coloring sheet has broad body areas, with finer sections along the dragon's belly, claws, and row of back spikes.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Climbing Platforms Inside Rumor Honeybottoms' Honey-filled Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman climbing platforms inside Rumor Honeybottoms' honey-filled tower, reaching upward beneath the crowned bee as honey drips over the ledges. Large hexagonal cells cover the wall behind them. The coloring sheet contrasts those geometric spaces and broad platforms with smaller wing veins, crown points, and Rumor's scepter.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Dodging Cannonballs on the Dock Beside Captain Brineybeard's Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman dodges cannonballs on the dock beside Captain Brineybeard's pirate ship in this printable coloring page, leaping above a ball near rope-wrapped posts and choppy water. The captain raises a fist above the ship's glaring face. Wooden planks, a large sail, and small rope sections fill out the nautical coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Dodging Stage Props During Sally Stageplay's Theater Performance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman dodging stage props during Sally Stageplay's theater performance, jumping over a rolling barrel beneath a crescent moon suspended from a rope. Sally stands behind him holding a fan beside the curtain. The coloring sheet combines broad costume and barrel shapes with smaller folds, floorboards, and motion marks.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Facing Werner Werman in His Tin-can Tank Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman faces Werner Werman in his tin-can tank in this printable coloring page, pointing toward the rat's cannon, open lid, and segmented tracks on bare ground. Werner peers over the rim wearing a helmet. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces across the can and Mugman's clothing, with smaller wheels, rivets, and whiskers.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Riding the Rail Trolley Beside the Phantom Express Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman riding the rail trolley beside the Phantom Express, gripping a hand lever next to the locomotive's jagged face and smoking funnel. Large train wheels run behind the smaller trolley. Repeated sleepers, rails, rivets, and wheel spokes add detailed sections around Mugman's broad clothing shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Parrying the Die on King Dice's Casino Game Board Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman parries the die on King Dice's casino game board in this printable coloring page, reaching an open glove toward its rounded corners and circular pips. A winding track and three gaming chips sit below his jumping pose. The coloring sheet offers broad board spaces alongside smaller straw stripes, chip segments, and impact marks.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Confronting the Devil in His Throne Room Beneath the Casino Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman confronting the Devil in his throne room beneath the casino, with raised fists opposite a horned figure holding a tall trident. The Devil sits on a pointed throne with a curved tail beside him. Jagged fur edges and small claws contrast with Mugman's smoother shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Flying His Airplane Over the Ocean While Facing Cala Maria Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman flies his airplane over the ocean while facing Cala Maria in this printable coloring page, with a turning propeller beside her tentacle hair and scaled tail. Cala Maria raises one hand above splashing waves. The coloring sheet includes broad wing and water shapes with smaller suction cups, scales, and shell details.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Battling Dr. Kahl's Robot in His Airplane Above the Junkyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman battling Doctor Kahl's Robot in his airplane above the junkyard, firing toward a heart-shaped chest panel beneath the doctor's open hatch. The robot reaches forward with large jointed hands. Piles of gears, pipes, and scrap provide smaller details around the broad plane and robot shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Caring for Baby Bottle Inside Elder Kettle's Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman cares for Baby Bottle inside Elder Kettle's cottage in this printable coloring page, cradling the smiling baby on a stool beside a table and teapot. A circular window and curtains frame the seated pair. The coloring sheet combines wide clothing areas with smaller hands, a scalloped collar, and narrow wooden floorboards.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Holding His Broken Handle While Searching for Glue Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman holding his broken handle while searching for glue, opening a drawer beside a pointed glue bottle on the small table. Jagged ends remain on his cup head and detached handle. His worried face, broad gloves, and simple furniture create clear sections across the mostly open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Facing the Mischievous Ghosts in the Graveyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman faces mischievous ghosts in the graveyard in this printable coloring page, recoiling with open hands beneath a cratered moon and two rounded gravestones on grassy ground. One ghost sticks out its tongue while another peers over a stone. The coloring sheet keeps broad body and sky spaces around the smaller faces and grass tufts.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Sneaking Into Ribby and Croaks' Club for Ice Cream Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman sneaking into Ribby and Croaks' club for ice cream, stepping between round tables while a large sundae waits on the counter. The boxing frogs stand near a curtained stage behind him. Wafer sticks, a cherry, stools, and wall panels add smaller shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Carrying the Dragon Egg Down Mount Eruptus Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman carries the dragon egg down Mount Eruptus in this printable coloring page, holding the large patterned egg with both gloves while following a rocky hillside path. A smoking volcano rises behind the distant ridges. The coloring sheet places small stones and curved egg markings around Mugman's larger face, clothing, and shoe shapes.

pages.title: Mugman Wearing Goggles in a Boat by a Volcano Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman wearing Dirk Dangerous goggles while riding a small boat toward Mount Eruptus, shading his eyes beneath a plume of volcanic smoke. His goggles rest above his face as he sits on the bench. Curved hull planks, narrow floorboards, and gentle water lines surround the larger character shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Fending Off the Giant Crab with a Scabbard Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman fends off a giant crab with a scabbard in this printable coloring page, gripping it with both hands opposite raised claws and tall eye stalks. The crab's jointed legs spread across a sandy shore. Broad shell and clothing areas contrast with small spots, pebbles, and curved water lines on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Reading a Pirate Romance Novel Beside a Cup of Tea Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mugman reading a pirate romance novel beside a cup of tea, seated in an armchair with a ship and heart on the book. Steam rises above the cup on a small round table. The coloring sheet has broad chair panels, with finer book pages, sail shapes, and decorative table legs.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman as Captain Mugbeard Aboard His Imagined Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman appears as Captain Mugbeard aboard his imagined pirate ship in this printable coloring page, wearing a tricorn hat and long coat while raising a curved sword. His other glove rests on the ship's wheel beneath a large sail. Smaller spokes, buttons, railing posts, and floorboards divide the surrounding areas of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Practicing the Piano with Ludwig Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman practicing the piano with Ludwig, whose gramophone-shaped head rises above a formal suit as he holds a conducting baton. Mugman sits at the keyboard on a round stool. The coloring sheet combines large piano and clothing panels with narrow keys, suit buttons, pedals, and small glove details.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Auditioning Blindfolded on Sally Stageplay's Theater Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman auditions blindfolded on Sally Stageplay's theater stage in this printable coloring page, extending one arm while holding his other gloved hand against his chest. A knotted cloth covers his eyes between tied curtains. The coloring sheet has broad open backdrop and clothing spaces, with smaller blindfold folds and parallel lines across the stage floor.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman and Cuphead Riding a Runaway Christmas Tree Through the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman and Cuphead riding a runaway Christmas tree through the snow, gripping the trunk above round ornaments and wide layered branches. Snowflakes and scattered snowballs frame their downhill pose. The coloring sheet contrasts broad character shapes with repeated needles, circular decorations, and rings at the end of the trunk.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman Showing Cuphead His Homemade Tandem Bicycle Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman shows Cuphead his homemade tandem bicycle in this printable coloring page, gesturing toward the long frame, two saddles, and paired pedals beneath their smiling faces. Cuphead watches with both hands on his hips. The coloring sheet has fine wheel spokes and chain details alongside the broader spaces in the brothers' heads and clothing.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman and Cuphead Flying on the Devil's Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman and Cuphead flying on the Devil's pitchfork, holding its long shaft above three rounded clouds with their legs hanging below. The three pointed prongs extend ahead of Mugman. Broad sky spaces surround the pair, while straw stripes and glove creases provide smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman in Inkwell Isle One Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman stands in Inkwell Isle One in this printable coloring page, raising a gloved fist beside a winding path, leafy tree, and cottage with an arched door. Flowers and bushes edge the path beneath distant hills. The coloring sheet balances his large face and plain shorts with smaller window frames, petals, and scattered stones.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman in Funfair Fever Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mugman in Funfair Fever, smiling with his hands on his hips beside a carousel horse, triangular bunting, and a blank decorative sign. A pointed canopy rises behind the horse. Broad character and sign spaces contrast with smaller flag stripes, glove marks, and carousel details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman in Djimmi Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman stands with Cuphead in Djimmi Desert in this printable coloring page, their arms around each other beneath a floating genie, crescent moon, and scattered stars. Pyramids and palm trees rise beyond the dunes. The coloring sheet gives the brothers broad open clothing areas while smaller shapes define the genie lamp and desert scenery.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman on Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mugman on a pirate ship, waving in a sailor collar while holding an anchor beneath a skull-and-crossbones flag and tall mast. A cannon and barrel sit on the deck behind him. The coloring sheet includes detailed ropes, railings, and planks around broader sail, sky, and character shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead Mugman in Porkrind Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Mugman stands with Cuphead in Porkrind's shop in this printable coloring page, beside a counter and cash register beneath a shelf of bottles, a barrel, and a crate. The pair smile in front of the wooden counter panels. The coloring sheet has broad clothing spaces, with smaller shelf goods, straw stripes, and glove details.
